notes.title: Check for update in the File menu
notes.text: File > Check for update (Ctrl+U) looks at GitHub and brings down the newest label tool straight away.

notes.title: The old template no longer comes back
notes.text: The app now keeps the newest copy of the tool, not the last one it happened to download.

notes.title: About shows both versions
notes.text: Help > About BoxUp Labels lists what is installed here and what is on GitHub right now, and says whether they match.
